description: Full IP intelligence for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, geolocation (country, city, state, postal code, lat/long, timezone, local time; blank fields are filled from a second and third public source only when that source places the IP in the same city and region, and a source that places it elsewhere is returned whole, labelled, as location_alternates rather than mixed in), ISP/ASN/org, ownership fields (ASN, owner name, network range, owner domain -- each with its source, null with a reason when no source states it; also nested as company.name / company.domain / company.network, with network_range_basis announced|registry and the registry allocation as registry_network_range), and security risk flags (VPN, proxy, Tor, datacenter, mobile + a 0-100 risk score) and an abuse signal (is_abuser: listed on a public abuse blocklist, with the lists that matched, plus the abuse contact of the network from the registry). For "which company owns this IP" call rdap_ip, the registry source for ownership; this tool adds geolocation and risk. Keyless.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8" or "2606:4700:4700::1111".
